segments.an1.616:1.1: “Amataṃ te, bhikkhave, na paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṃ na paribhuñjanti.
segments.an1.616:1.2: Amataṃ te, bhikkhave, paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṃ paribhuñjantī”ti.
segments.an1.617:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, aparibhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparibhuttā.
segments.an1.617:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, paribhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati paribhuttā”ti.
segments.an1.618:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, parihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati parihīnā.
segments.an1.618:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, aparihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparihīnā”ti.
segments.an1.619:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, viraddhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati viraddhā.
segments.an1.619:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, āraddhaṃ [aviraddhaṃ (ka.)] yesaṃ kāyagatāsati āraddhā”ti.
segments.an1.620:1.1: “Amataṃ te, bhikkhave, pamādiṃsu ye kāyagatāsatiṃ pamādiṃsu.
segments.an1.620:1.2: Amataṃ te, bhikkhave, na pamādiṃsu ye kāyagatāsatiṃ na pamādiṃsu”.
segments.an1.621:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, pamuṭṭhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pamuṭṭhā.
segments.an1.621:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, appamuṭṭhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati appamuṭṭhā”ti.
segments.an1.622:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, anāsevitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anāsevitā.
segments.an1.622:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, āsevitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati āsevitā”ti.
segments.an1.623:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, abhāvitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhāvitā.
segments.an1.623:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, bhāvitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati bhāvitā”ti.
segments.an1.624:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, abahulīkataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abahulīkatā.
segments.an1.624:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, bahulīkataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati bahulīkatā”ti.
segments.an1.625:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anabhiññātā.
segments.an1.625:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, abhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhiññātā”ti.
segments.an1.626:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, apariññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati apariññātā.
segments.an1.626:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, pariññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pariññātā”ti.
segments.an1.627:1.1: “Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, asacchikataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati asacchikatā.
segments.an1.627:1.2: Amataṃ tesaṃ, bhikkhave, sacchikataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati sacchikatā”ti.(….)[(ekakanipātassa suttasahassaṃ samattaṃ.)(sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)]
segments.an1.627:2.1: (Idamavoca bhagavā. Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.)[() etthantare pāṭho sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu natthi]

lines: 600-611. Amataṃ te, bhikkhave, na paribhuñjantīti maraṇavirahitaṃ nibbānaṃ na paribhuñjantīti attho.
Nanu ca nibbānaṃ lokuttaraṃ, kāyagatāsati lokiyā, kathaṃ taṃ paribhuñjantā amataṃ paribhuñjantīti?
Kāyagatañhi satiṃ bhāvento amatamadhigacchati, abhāvento nādhigacchati.
600-611. Natthi ettha mataṃ maraṇaṃ vināsoti amataṃ, nibbānanti āha –
Amatassa vā nibbānassa adhigamahetutāya amatasadisaatappakasukhapatitatāya ca kāyagatāsati “amatan”ti vuttā.
